name: VTS
positioning: The leasing pipeline for office landlords — every tour, proposal and lease in one view, plus a demand index nobody else has.
description: VTS is a leasing and asset management platform for commercial landlords: deal pipeline, space availability, tenant and broker activity, portfolio reporting, and the VTS Market and Activate products covering marketing and tenant experience. Its VTS Office Demand Index derives leading indicators from platform activity.
real_estate_use: Office leasing runs on a pipeline that traditionally lived in a leasing director's spreadsheet. VTS makes it institutional: every requirement, tour and proposal is tracked, so an asset manager can forecast occupancy and compare a proposed deal against portfolio standards. Because a large share of US office space transacts on the platform, aggregated tour activity becomes a market signal weeks ahead of signed-lease data.
features: Leasing deal pipeline with tours, proposals and approvals
Portfolio occupancy and lease expiry reporting
VTS Market for online marketing of available space
Office Demand Index from aggregated platform activity

use_cases.job: Forecast occupancy from a real leasing pipeline rather than from a spreadsheet
Track every requirement and proposal on a landlord's portfolio in one system
